prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Deep Orbit hand-drawn cel-shaded narrative scene,1536x1024 landscape. First reference is authoritative canonical Demir identity, age, face proportions, brown eyes, tousled dark hair, freckles, short stubble, single earpiece and charcoal uniform. Second reference is approved dashboard station ROOM ARCHITECTURE ONLY, not its old diagrams or coloring. Last reference is exact scene to restage. Keep muted sage #6BAA8A, aged brass #A89060 and charcoal/navy, natural tan skin and modest practical lighting, no neon lime, no glossy 3D. Balanced stylized adult proportions, coherent neck/shoulders, exactly two plausible arm chains and two hands with five fingers each, hands naturally supported. Every monitor faces its operator, and camera views it from beside operator on same FRONT side. All text, rows and borders follow the physical display plane and shared vanishing point. Keep the character's face visible in natural three-quarter view; eyes follow actual work. No camera gaze, no outward demonstration cards, no held tablets, no writing through device backs. Remove all decorative waveforms and unrelated screens; inactive peripheral displays dark. Use only exact specified concise screen content, no invented measurements or successes. Let the scene feel like a spontaneous thoughtful crew moment, not a presentation photograph. Late-watch candid moment at the dashboard alcove. Demir sits RIGHT, torso and chair turned toward a work monitor LEFT, clearly on its front side. He pauses over a flat closed maintenance notebook, one palm resting on it, other hand naturally on mouse. His brows lift with curious concern rather than celebration, a small thoughtful half-smile as he spots an absent match. No papers or devices held up. A desk lamp and an untouched mug lend lived-in quiet. Exact main screen heading "Retained cache log", line "Anomaly: no matching hit", and a separated next-action line "Raw capture comparison: pending". This absence concerns retained keys only. Do not imply the source never repeats. All other screens dark. Preserve dashboard master architecture, muted colors, and canonical Demir identity. Compose him and the work screen as a natural diagonal, not a centered portrait.
meaning: Epilogue Demir finds no anomaly hit in retained cache log and states raw captures must be compared before judging repetition. Capture comparison remains pending.
